steps.content: Beyond the surging crowd stands a towering set of three-dimensional artworks.

The painting's palette is subdued, yet its arrangement resonates with fervor—a charging bull, a warhorse in terrified wails, contorted human figures writhing in agony... and amidst the desolate ruins, struggling flowers reaching for bloom.
It is the kind of work that pierces one's soul upon first gaze, an impactful expression that leaves viewers profoundly shaken.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Ahem, didn't think the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control would be here too. Place is packed over there. Let's just skip the crowd and keep moving on our tour!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Take a look at this, everyone! Right before us is the most famous masterpiece in this Outland exhibition—Lamentur!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Not quite getting it? That's absolutely okay! This is Outland art, after all. It's meant to challenge us. The important thing is knowing you're looking at something truly legendary!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Created by an unknown artist, it features sharp brushstrokes and dramatic shapes. The composition may seem chaotic at first glance, but the piece possesses a deeply moving, heart-wrenching power. Reportedly, it depicts the horrors of a devastating war.

She intended to delve into more details and showcase her extensive knowledge, but a quick glance at the comment stream tells Thalia everything—DisCity viewers have no interest in tales from the Outlands.
Ever the professional, she immediately changes course and zeroes in on what really matters.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Today, this incredibly special masterpiece isn't just being exhibited at the Great Expo—it's going up for auction for the very first time ever!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: For all of you watching from home, care to guess the final bid? Who do you think will walk away with this masterpiece? Remember, this isn't just another piece—it's the crown jewel of the entire exhibition!
Yet to her surprise, the audience's focus continues to waver.
No sooner has Thalia finished speaking than the crowd nearby erupts into startled exclamations.
On stage, amidst the paintings, a figure of grace suddenly emerges, capturing the undivided attention of all present.
